methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.
Seek an exact dirty-input or chronological-cut counterexample to the proposed replacement.

original_card.bottleneck_link: A legitimate replacement could admit a cheaper bit circuit; scalar savings alone do not alter the selected moment.

actual_scope: PR2407 Open next question 2: under ONE live private COPY slot (each retained column gets one contiguous chronological COPY interval of cuts of the fixed ideal303 deferred undo, intervals non-overlapping, same-cut handoff allowed), can several R439 columns be interleaved with the 303 fixed target undo gates to give a complete scalar scatter below 88? Exact witness: 84 scatter ADDs (11,057 complete ADDs), with every undo gate, the nine rank-7 COPY/ERASE pairs, the 2,911 ordered MOVEs and paid rank mass 5,129 unchanged.
scope_change_reason: The original H2/K replacement lemma is covered by retained PR1194/1311/1806, and starship-s narrowed the same card to native handoff (PR2421). PR2407 TASK.json open question 2 (coordinated one-slot multi-column interleaving) was explicitly unsearched and unclaimed; it is concrete and priced before implementation.
bottleneck_link: Finite scalar side result on the bit supplier word: every recursive rank charge and the paid histogram {1:1323,2:1342,3:79,4:44,5:102,6:11,7:19} are unchanged, so there is no kappa change and no selected-supplier admission. It shows the one-slot lifetime constraint is not what stops multi-column scatter savings on this word.
stop_rule: Search wall time <= 15 min (nice, single process, <1.5 GB); stop at experiment deadline minus 25 min. Packaged seeded search: seed 6 (30,000 tabu walks) and seed 606 (60,000 walks), each followed by an exact DP over the pooled options; both reach 84 and nothing lower. No claim that 84 is optimal.
evidence: WITNESS.json (9 segments, 84 taps); verify.py full 661-dirty-column forward/backward literal replay, invoice, precision guards, byte-identical PR2407 calibration streams and 13 rejecting controls; RESULT.json receipt; the SEARCH.json DP alternative 84 schedule (same for both seeds) also passes the full replay; search/search.py seeded search record SEARCH.json (failed search beyond 84, exact weight<=4 exclusion per column).
